nodes.characterization_summary: PC-1 and PC-2 show peaks for CoFe-PBA with cubic crystal system Fm3m; PC-2 peaks negatively shifted by 0.43° in 2θ compared to PC-1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) patterns of PC-1 and PC-2 show the peaks for CoFe-PBA with a cubic crystal system [space group: Fm3m (225) Oh6 for PC-1 and Fm3m (225) Oh5 for PC-2] ... In PC-2, the PXRD peaks are negatively shifted by 0.43° in 2 theta values compared to PC-1.

nodes.characterization_summary: PC-2 shows -NO stretching at 1940 cm⁻¹ and bridging -CN at 2185 cm⁻¹; PC-1 shows -CN at 2078 cm⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The infrared (IR) spectrum of PC-2 shows the peaks for the stretching vibrations of -NO at 1940 cm⁻¹ and bridging -CN group at 2185 cm⁻¹ ... the peak for the bridged -CN group is positively shifted in PC-2 compared to PC-1 (2078 cm⁻¹).

nodes.characterization_summary: PC-1 and PC-2 Co 2p, Fe 2p, N 1s peaks show electronic modulation by -NO; PC-2 Co 2p3/2 782.96 eV (+0.59 eV), Fe 2p Fe2+ 710.50 eV (+2.40 eV), N 1s -CN 397.10 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Co 2p3/2 peak of PC-2 showed a positive shift of 0.59 eV compared to that of PC-1 ... The -NO group in PC-2 increases the effective positive charge on Fe and positively shifts the peak assigned for the low-spin Fe2+ by 2.40 eV (710.50 eV in PC-2 vs 708.10 eV in PC-1) ... The peaks at 397.93 eV and 397.10 eV were observed for -CN bond in PC-1 and PC-2, respectively.

properties.description: Fe 2p XPS spectrum for PC-1, binding energy range 700-775 eV
Fe 2p XPS spectrum for PC-2, binding energy range 700-775 eV

nodes.characterization_summary: PC-1 and PC-2 show cubic morphology of agglomerated particles; AC-1 and AC-2 show ultrathin nanosheet morphology.
nodes.evidence_snippet: SEM image shows the cubic morphology of the particles with varying sizes for PC-1 and PC-2 ... SEM images have shown the ultrathin nanosheet morphology of AC-1 and AC-2.

nodes.characterization_summary: PC-1 cubic particles, HRTEM d-spacing 0.50 nm (200) plane; PC-2 d-spacing 0.51 nm; AC-2 ultrathin nanosheets, HRTEM 0.27 nm (101) α-Co(OH)₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Further, the formation of cubic particles of PC-1 and PC-2 was confirmed by TEM studies ... HRTEM image of PC-1 reveals the well-resolved lattice fringes with a d-spacing of 0.50 nm corresponding to the (200) plane of CoFe-PBA ... HRTEM image detects the d-spacing of 0.27 nm assigned for (101) plane of α-Co(OH)₂ in AC-2.

nodes.characterization_summary: PC-1 and PC-2 contain Co, Fe, C, N; AC-1 and AC-2 contain Co, Fe, O.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Energy dispersive X-ray (EDX) spectra detected the elements Co, Fe, C, and N in both precatalysts ... EDX spectra also showed the presence of Co, Fe, and O in AC-1 and AC-2.

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-1 and AC-2 show mixed-phase α-Co(OH)₂ (JCPDS 48-0083) and β-Co(O)OH (JCPDS 26-0480).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The PXRD patterns of AC-1 and AC-2 revealed the formation of the mixed-phase α-Co(OH)₂ (JCPDS No. 48-0083) and β-Co(O)OH (JCPDS-No. 26-0480).

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-2 shows higher Co3+ (Co3+/Co2+=1.1 vs 0.9 in AC-1), mixed Fe2+/Fe3+; Co 2p3/2, Fe 2p3/2, O 1s binding energies positively shifted ~0.57-0.65 eV vs AC-1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In AC-2, the Co2p3/2 signal has been fitted into two peaks corresponding to Co3+ (781.07 eV) and Co2+ (783.02 eV) ... The presence of a higher amount of Co3+ in AC-2 than in AC-1 was also confirmed by ... Co3+/Co2+ = 0.9 in AC-1 and Co3+/Co2+ = 1.1 in AC-2 ... The Co2p3/2, Fe2p3/2 and O 1s signals in AC-2 showed a positive shift (≈0.57 eV in Co2p3/2, ≈0.61 eV in Fe2p3/2, ≈0.65 eV in O1s) in the binding energies compared to AC-1.

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-2 shows low pre-edge intensity (~7709 eV) indicating LS Oh Co³⁺, peak shift to higher energy vs AC-1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Co K-edge XANES reveals the low intensity of the pre-edge peak (≈7709 eV) for AC-2 while the intensity of the main absorption peak (≈7729 eV) is high ... The Co-edge XANES spectrum also reveals a peak shift to higher energy for AC-2.

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-2 dominant LS Co³⁺; AC-1 mixed HS Co²⁺ and LS Co³⁺.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Co L-edge spectrum of AC-1 shows two peaks at 777.1 eV and 780.4 eV suggesting the octahedral Co²⁺ and Co³⁺ species ... The relative intensity of the peak at 780.4 eV is higher for AC-2, indicating LS Co³⁺.

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-2 pre-edge 7114.70 eV dominant octahedral Fe³⁺; AC-1 mixed Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Fe K-edge XANES of AC-2 shows a pre-edge feature at 7114.70 eV indicating the dominance of octahedrally coordinated Fe³⁺ ions ... AC-1 shows clearly a different pre-edge feature that demonstrates the mixed Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺ oxidation states.

properties.description: Iron K-edge X-ray Absorption Near Edge Structure spectrum

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-2 higher Fe³⁺ intensity at 709.7 eV; AC-1 mixed valent Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The higher intensity of the peak at 709.7 eV in AC-2 indicates the presence of higher amount of Fe³⁺ in AC-2.

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-2 shows Co-O contraction (~1.50 Å), Fe-O contraction (~1.50 Å) indicating higher Co³⁺/Fe³⁺ valence states.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Co-R-space of AC-2 shows two peaks around 1.50Å and 2.60Å representing the nearest Co-O and Co-Co coordination, respectively ... The Fe-O bond is contracted in AC-2 compared to AC-1.

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-2 d-spacing 0.27 nm (101) α-Co(OH)₂; SAED indexed for β-Co(O)OH and α-Co(OH)₂ planes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HRTEM image detects the d-spacing of 0.27 nm assigned for (101) plane of α-Co(OH)₂ in AC-2 while AC-1 shows d-spacing 0.50 nm ... SAED pattern has been indexed for the (150), (131), (040), (120) planes of β-Co(O)OH.

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-1 thickness 8-10 nm; AC-2 thickness 3-5 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The atomic force microscopy (AFM) study confirms the thickness of ultrathin nanosheets of 8-10 nm for AC-1 and 3-5 nm for AC-2.

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-2 shows lower charge transfer resistance Rct compared to AC-1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The electrochemical impedance spectroscopic (EIS) studies showed a lower charge transfer resistance (Rct) for AC-2 compared to AC-1.

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance measurement gives ECSA of AC-2 87.25±3.25 cm² and AC-1 74.00±2.75 cm².
nodes.evidence_snippet: The ECSA of AC-2 was calculated to be 87.25±3.25 cm², higher than that of AC-1 (74.00±2.75 cm², Figure 4f and S27).

nodes.characterization_summary: C 1s and O 1s spectra of PC-1 and PC-2 show characteristic peaks with shifts in PC-2 due to different coordination environments.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The C 1s (Figure S4-S5) and O 1s (Figure S6-S7) spectra of PC-1 and PC-2 were fitted into their characteristic peaks ... A shift of the C 1s and O 1s peaks has also been detected for PC-2 when compared with PC-1.
